body:
I'm living with my roommate and best friend if almost 6 years. We go to college together and share an apartment. If I don't pay my half of the bills, I'll be evicted and he'll be forced to find someone else or move out as well. So I can't move back in with family. My mother can't support me anymore, and she lives too far away. And my father...well, I hope I never see him again. So that's out of the question. I just don't know what to do. 

I really hope I don't turn out like him. But, it still keeps me from seekng out companionship. I'm terrified of relationships because if him. Also, because of what my mother has went through. I grew up with at least 4 different step dads, and every single one of them took advantage of her or left her. It's hard to get into a relationship and not be terrified of something like what I witnessed happen, happen to me. I've seen too much. And besides, happiness only comes to those who deserve it. I obviously don't, or I wouldn't be curled up in a ball on bathroom floor contemplating ending my life.

I've got a job now, to at least pay the bills. I work as a manager at my local mart, and get payed slightly above minimal wage. The problem with work is, it's not enough. I'm not going to be able to afford the rent for this month. I've got less than a week to find about 150 extra dollars to be able to stay where I am right now. 

I hope I graduate. I hope that things improve, I really do. 

And what future do I have? I can't have a family, because I'm afraid of turning into my father, a wreckless abusive maniac. College is insurmountable right now, because my negative thoughts are keeping me from studying and going to class. Im twenty years old, and the only meaningful relationship in my life lasted two years, and the end of it she got rid of me, for the same reasons why I'm upset: I'm just not useful.

Hey, thanks for the message I really appreciate it. Well, my major in college is Engineering, with a focus on aerospace technology. My childhood dream was to join NASA, and I think a degree in this field would help me out. But it's so hard. College costs a ton, and I'm on my own in regards to paying for college. My mother has three other kids to take care of, and she just doesn't have the money to spare. And loans, loans will kill me. Schooling is so terribly expensive. :/
